emphasized.$description: Expo-out feel for premium micro-interactions (modals, popovers entering)

linear.$description: Constant-rate motion, no ease-in/ease-out. A cubic bezier from (0,0) to (1,1) is mathematically a straight line, so this renders identically to the CSS `linear` keyword — expressed as a cubicBezier token instead of a special-cased literal so it goes through the same build pipeline as every other easing token (the CSS cubicBezier/css transform, the TS array export). Added 2026-08-16 for Skeleton's wave shimmer, which previously hardcoded the literal `linear` keyword with no token backing — a continuous looping gradient sweep needs a constant rate; any of the other curves would introduce an uneven, distracting acceleration/deceleration on each loop.
